versions.changelog: Ownership migrated to the trustgrowth org; content unchanged from 1.0.0

Initial release of keyword-report skill.

- Generate periodic keyword position reports showing quick wins, striking distance, and position movement from search-console or TrustGrowth sources.
- Normalizes and labels all data sources (Measured/User-provided/Estimated).
- Summarizes keyword movement, highlights action items, and includes actionable details in main report; full data can be exported to CSV by request.
- Adheres to strict evidence and ethics rules—traces all claims to source, never mixes data types, and clearly indicates measurement method.
- Designed to complement, not replace, keyword discovery (`keyword-scout`) or strategy (`content-strategy`) workflows.
